_about: Fixed thresholds for the backgammon benchmark site (brief B9). Written and committed before any site number was computed; never changed after seeing results. Every value here is shown on the Method page.
_about_risk: Brief v10 B6/B9: margin 0.001 (main) and 0.02 (robustness) for Safety pays / Risk pays and for right vs wrong risk; stake bands small < 0.02 <= medium <= 0.08 < big; Confidence-tab cutoffs 0.90 and 0.99; 300 game-level half splits. Fixed and committed before any v10 risk number was computed.
cutoff_split_rule: On one half of the games (a game's decisions together), the lowest probability cutoff whose kept decisions (probability at or above it) hold no blunder; scored on the other half: share kept and blunder rate among kept, averaged over cutoff_split_runs seeded splits.
